/**
   * Adds a card to the database. Set `withNewUID` to add the card with a
   * fresh UID if a card is being copied (rather than moved) from one
   * directory to another.
   *
   * This card does not need to be of the same type as the database, e.g., one
   * can add an nsIAbLDAPCard to an nsIAbMDBDirectory.
   *
   * @return "Real" card (eg nsIAbLDAPCard) that can be used for some
   *         extra functions.
   */
  nsIAbCard addCard(in nsIAbCard card, [optional] in boolean withNewUID);
